summary: This informational document explains Self-Delimiting Numeric Values, a field type that encodes arbitrarily large non-negative integers or bit strings compactly. The length is implied by the data, so protocols can grow without fixed field sizes. It was introduced in Delay-Tolerant Networking protocols.

eli5.summary: A number that tells you where it ends, so it can be short when small and long when big, with no wasted space or fixed width.

questions: variable length integer encoding in dtn
